in_marathi.name: Fizaara
in_marathi.long_meaning: Fizaara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Fiz', meaning 'fruitful' or 'abundant'. This name is often given to a child born during a prosperous time or to symbolize a prosperous future.
